# MagicSchool

> MagicSchool is an AI operating system for K-12 education that empowers teachers, students, and district leaders with 80+ AI tools for teaching, learning, and school operations—all built with privacy, safety, and compliance at its core.

MagicSchool serves educators across multiple roles—from classroom teachers to superintendents—with integrated AI tools designed to reduce teacher burnout, improve student learning outcomes, and support responsible AI adoption in schools. The platform is FERPA, GDPR, and COPPA compliant, with deep integrations into popular learning management systems like Google Classroom and Canvas.
